rca of the issue: RCA: series_from_title removes trailing keyword patterns too aggressively after extracting parenthetical text. Repro: POST /api/books with title 'Titel (Meine Reihe, Band 2)'; response series_name becomes 'Meine'. Mitigation: preserve full phrase before part-token cleanup (remove only band/part tokens, not semantic word 'Reihe' in middle/end).
